name: Lighteval
summary: Hugging Face toolkit for evaluating LLMs across local and served-model backends, with customizable tasks, metrics and per-sample results.
description: Install lighteval (PyPI 0.13.0; Python 3.10+). Offers Inspect AI, Accelerate, vLLM, SGLang and endpoint-based entry points, plus custom task/model interfaces. Stores detailed sample-level results for debugging rather than only aggregate scores. MIT framework; individual benchmark datasets retain their own terms and model-provider/compute costs are separate. README says Windows is untested and unsupported.

agent_access.notes: Local Python package and CLI: pip install lighteval. Credentials depend on chosen hosted provider; local model backends are also supported.
